[[Droknar's Knives]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] obtained from the [[Assassin's Chest]] at the [[Epilogue]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Dazed]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item shares a [[skin]] with [[Droknar's Blades]], [[Droknar's Daggers]], [[Ungues of the Oni]], [[Ungues of the Forgotten]] and [[Mallyx's Zeal]] (though each varies in color).
